name: Newton (Massachusetts, United States)
description: Vertical tricolour of gold, black and gold, the black pale charged with the city seal in gold.
history: Newton is a city in Middlesex County, Massachusetts. The flag was adopted in 1955 (according to Flags of the World; the design is prescribed by section 1-11 of the city's revised ordinances of 1973 as a field of gold with a black pale bearing the seal).

features.role: city seal in gold with black lettering, John Eliot preaching, reading NEWTON LIBERTY AND UNION NONANTUM
